description.p: PDFchemy Tools is a fast, 100% offline, privacy-first document utility. All PDF operations execute locally on your machine with zero cloud uploads and zero telemetry.

ul.li: Compress PDFs with customized DPI and JPEG quality presets
Merge multiple documents with drag-and-drop file reordering
Split, rotate, and extract specific page ranges
Reflow Reader with dark/sepia reading themes and scalable typography
128-bit/256-bit AES PDF password encryption and decryption
Extract plain text and convert documents locally

description.p: Initial official desktop release for Windows and Linux.
